title: Bound on a list maximum
statement: Let $f$ map a type $\alpha$ to the natural numbers, let $l$ be a list of elements of $\alpha$, and let $F$ be a natural number. The recursively defined maximum of the values of $f$ on $l$ (with value $0$ for the empty list) is at most $F$ if and only if $f(y)\le F$ for every $y$ in $l$.
